Khaleej Restaurant product image files

Menu cards look for these files at /images/products/<filename>. All 147 files are included. To refresh them from Wikimedia Commons, run "npm run images:products"; source details and licences are recorded in data/product-image-credits.json. If a file is absent, the menu shows a styled placeholder with the item name.
